meaning: to press something to move it away from you
example: Please push the door to open it.

meaning: to hold something and move it towards you
example: Pull the chair closer to the table.

meaning: to send something through the air with your hand
example: Please don't throw plastic bags on the road.

meaning: to stop and hold something that is moving through the air
example: Can you catch the ball?

meaning: to push yourself up off the ground into the air
example: The kids jump on the bed every evening.

meaning: to go up something like stairs, a tree or a hill
example: We climbed the hill early in the morning.

meaning: to hit something with your foot
example: He kicked the football very hard.

meaning: to lean your body forward or curve something
example: Bend your knees and lift the box.

meaning: to bend cloth or paper so one part lies over another
example: Please fold the clothes and keep them in the cupboard.

meaning: to make a liquid flow out of a container
example: Pour some water into the glass.

meaning: to move something so that it is no longer closed
example: Can you open the window, please?

meaning: to shut something so that it is not open
example: Please close the door when you leave.

meaning: to move your hand to say hello or goodbye
example: She waved at us from the bus.
exampleTamil: அவ பஸ்ல இருந்து எங்களை பார்த்து கை அசைச்சா.

meaning: to hit your hands together to show you like something
example: Everyone clapped after his speech.
exampleTamil: அவன் பேச்சுக்குப் பிறகு எல்லாரும் கை தட்டினாங்க.

meaning: to clean something by rubbing it with a cloth
example: Wipe the table before we eat.

meaning: to put colour on a wall or surface with a brush
example: We are going to paint the house next month.
exampleTamil: நாங்க அடுத்த மாசம் வீட்டுக்கு பெயின்ட் அடிக்கப் போறோம்.

meaning: to put a seed or young tree in the ground
example: Let us plant a mango tree in the garden.

meaning: to fasten something with a rope, string or knot
example: Tie your shoelaces before you run.

meaning: to put things together so they become one
example: Mix the flour and water well.

meaning: to say something very loudly
example: Do not shout at the children.

meaning: to make happy sounds because something is funny
example: We laughed a lot at his joke.
exampleTamil: அவன் ஜோக்கை கேட்டு நாங்க ரொம்ப சிரிச்சோம்.

meaning: to have tears come from your eyes
example: The baby started to cry at night.

meaning: to turn your mouth up to show you are happy
example: She always smiles when she sees me.

meaning: to move on foot at a normal speed
example: I walk to the office every morning.
exampleTamil: நான் தினமும் காலையில ஆபீஸுக்கு நடந்து போவேன்.

meaning: to move on foot faster than walking
example: He runs five kilometres every day.

meaning: to rest your body on a chair or the floor
example: Please sit here and wait for me.

meaning: to put something where no one can see it
example: She likes to hide the gift under the bed.
exampleTamil: அவ பரிசை கட்டிலுக்கு அடியில மறைச்சு வைக்க விரும்புவா.

meaning: to look carefully for something
example: I searched everywhere for my keys.

meaning: to move something quickly up and down or side to side
example: Shake the bottle before you use it.

meaning: to start a machine or light so it works
example: Please turn on the fan.

meaning: to stop a machine or light so it does not work
example: Turn off the lights before you sleep.

meaning: to pull something heavy slowly along the ground
example: I dragged the heavy bag to the car.

meaning: to pull your body or something out to make it longer
example: Stretch your arms before you start running.

meaning: to press something hard from the sides
example: Squeeze a lemon into the glass of juice.

meaning: to rub your skin with your nails
example: Do not scratch the mosquito bite.

meaning: to move your hand or a cloth firmly over something
example: Rub your hands together to keep warm.

meaning: to join cloth using a needle and thread
example: My mother can sew a button very quickly.

meaning: to make a hole in the ground
example: We will dig a deep hole for the new tree.

meaning: to turn something around by holding both ends
example: Twist the cap to open the bottle.

meaning: to pull paper or cloth apart into pieces
example: Be careful not to tear the page.

meaning: to bite food many times in your mouth
example: Chew your food slowly.

meaning: to move food or drink down your throat
example: It hurts when I swallow.

meaning: to move on your hands and knees
example: The baby is learning to crawl.

meaning: to bend your body or rest against something
example: Do not lean on the wall.

meaning: to move your head up and down to say yes
example: He nodded when I asked the question.

meaning: to take hold of something quickly and firmly
example: Grab your bag and let us go.

meaning: to go and bring something back
example: Can you fetch a glass of water for me?

meaning: to take the skin off a fruit or vegetable
example: Please peel the potatoes for dinner.

meaning: to cover a surface with a thin layer or open something out
example: Spread some butter on the bread.

meaning: to return something to its proper place
example: Put away your toys after playing.
exampleTamil: விளையாடி முடிச்சதும் உன் பொம்மைகளை எடுத்து வை.
